description: Cross-tabulates an outcome metric by multiple demographic dimensions simultaneously, computing Disparate Impact ratios and applying the 80% rule. Groups smaller than n_suppress are replaced with '<10' to protect privacy.

metric_column.description: Numeric outcome to disaggregate (e.g. gpa, graduation_rate, completion_pct)

group_columns.description: Two or more demographic columns to cross-tabulate (e.g. pell_recipient, first_gen, ethnicity)

reference_group.description: Reference value per group_column in the same order (e.g. ['non-Pell', 'continuing-gen'])

n_suppress.description: Suppress cell counts below this threshold (default 10)
